content: विहित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Done, performed, made, acted. .²2 Arranged, fixed, settled, appointed, determined. .²3 Ordered, prescribed, decreed; विहिता व्यङ्गिता तेषाम् <ls>Pt. 1. 201</ls>. .²4 Framed, constructed. .²5 Placed, deposited. .²6 Furnished with, possessed of. .²7 Fit to be done. .²8 Distributed, apportioned. (See धा with वि). .{@-तम्@} An order, a command, decree; परतो दैवविहितायत्तम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>.
